# NeoOrm

> TypeScript-first SQL ORM: schema → codegen → typed client for PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, and MariaDB. You own the SQL; it handles the boilerplate.

## Guide

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, scaffold a project, first migration, Studio.
- [Examples](docs/examples.md): end-to-end schema and query patterns, including the blog example.
- [CLI](docs/cli.md): `init`, `generate`, `migrate`, and `studio` commands.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): `neoorm.config.ts` and datasource setup.
- [Studio](docs/studio.md): local data browser and schema explorer.
- [Migrations](docs/migrations.md): migration workflow and `dbPush`.
- [Seeding](docs/seeding.md): `neoorm seed`, environments, idempotent seeds.

## Schema and validation

- [Schema DSL](docs/schema.md): tables, columns, indexes (including partial), relations.
- [Zod](docs/zod.md): Zod validation schemas from the schema.
- [TypeBox](docs/typebox.md): TypeBox validation schemas from the schema.
- [Elysia](docs/elysia.md): Elysia integration.

## Queries

- [Queries](docs/queries.md): `findMany`, `findUnique`, writes, filters, pagination, aggregations.
- [Relations](docs/relations.md): `with` reads, nested writes, many-to-many.
- [Transactions](docs/transactions.md): interactive transactions and isolation.

## Dialects

- [SQLite](docs/sqlite.md): SQLite specifics and limitations.
- [MySQL](docs/mysql.md): MySQL 8 specifics and limitations.
- [MariaDB](docs/mariadb.md): MariaDB 10.11 specifics and limitations.

## Reference

- [Errors](docs/errors.md): error codes and handling.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): column-type plugins (PostGIS and custom).
- [API docstring conventions](docs/api-docstrings.md): TSDoc rules for contributors (docstrings ship in IDE hovers and `.d.ts`).
